title: William W NDE 6292
content: In the summer of 1985 I was at a beach in California with my family. There was a picnic area away from sight of the Ocean and my family was up there eating. I walked down to the beach by myself. I walked into the water up to my knees. The water was cold and very murky with kelp floating all around me. After my legs got use to the cold, I walked out a little further up to my waist. My mother didn't want me going out that far so I turned around to see if she was watching. While facing the shore a large wave hit me and slammed my face into the sandy bottom. The wind was knocked out of me. I stood up to take a breath of air and another large wave hit me, slamming my face into the sandy bottom again. I started to panic because I had no air and I was taking in water through my mouth and nose. I stood up again to get some air and was struck again by a large wave. At this point, I was in full panic and thoughts of death came to mind. All of a sudden, I felt very peaceful and calm. I heard a male inner voice say ‘relax and let go.’ So I did. I stopped fighting and just accepted what was going on. It didn't matter to me any more if I lived or died because I got the sense that I could never die because I have always existed and I always will. It was quiet and still. I felt like I was in a womb filled with amniotic fluid and pure love. There was no time it just didn't exist and it didn't matter. Suddenly I popped up about 30 yards to the north of where I first stepped into the ocean. I was coughing and I may have vomited I'm not sure. My face hurt but I felt good. I went back up to the picnic area where my family was and they asked me what happened to your face? I looked into the car mirror and saw that my face was scratched and swollen from the sandy bottom when the wave slammed me into it. I didn't tell anyone until I was an adult because I didn't think anyone would believe me and I didn't want to get into trouble with my mother for going too far out into the ocean. My NDE has changed the way I perceive the universe forever.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Suddenly he 'popped up about 30 yards to the north of where I first stepped into the ocean.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Near-drowning with panic shifting to peace; inner voice; sense of eternal existence; 'womb' sensation; sudden relocation/resurfacing.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE/tunnel/light/life review described; instead panic transitioned to peace with an inner voice, followed by sudden resurfacing at a different location.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He reports suddenly 'popped up about 30 yards to the north' of where he entered the ocean after hearing an inner voice and letting go.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “relax and let go.”; “I got the sense that I could never die because I have always existed and I always will.”; “I felt like I was in a womb filled with amniotic fluid and pure love.”; “There was no time it just didn't exist and it didn't matter.”
